name: NPZ Ocean Ecosystem Model
description:
Nutrient-Phytoplankton-Zooplankton model for marine ecosystem dynamics. Source: Franks (2002), J Marine Research.

Version 1.8 preserves all local equations and coefficients and uses explicit Radau on the unchanged output grid to prevent nutrient positivity overshoot. No egestion recycling term has been invented: summed nitrogen changes by -(1-gamma)*grazing, so the local system has an unspecified unassimilated-grazing loss. Whether that loss represents export or a missing closed-cycle return remains unresolved; numerical convergence does not certify Franks source fidelity or nutrient accounting.

flows.name: Nutrient_Uptake
flows.equation: -Vm * Nutrient * Phytoplankton / (Ks + Nutrient) + m_P * Phytoplankton + m_Z * Zooplankton

flows.name: Phyto_Growth
flows.equation: Vm * Nutrient * Phytoplankton / (Ks + Nutrient) - G * Zooplankton * Phytoplankton / (Kg + Phytoplankton) - m_P * Phytoplankton

flows.name: Zoo_Growth
flows.equation: gamma * G * Zooplankton * Phytoplankton / (Kg + Phytoplankton) - m_Z * Zooplankton

reference: Franks PJS. NPZ Models of Plankton Dynamics: Their Construction, Coupling to Physics, and Application. Journal of Oceanography. 2002;58:379-387. Review background; the specific local equations, missing unassimilated-grazing return and calibration have not been verified against a published equation set.
